title: EFC — v2.2 Cross-Field Integration Summary
abstract: This paper presents Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) as a cross-disciplinary framework in which energy flow and entropy are treated as universal variables that generate structure and constrain stability across physical, biological, and socio-technical systems. It synthesizes non-equilibrium thermodynamics, synergetics, and energy-rate density scaling to propose an adaptive window of energy throughput for sustained complexity, and illustrates applications in climate/urban heat, AI systems, and economic networks.
